svg.text: Reading a big SRS in 6 steps

g.text: 1. Big picture — Purpose, Scope, Users (write a 3–5 line summary)
2. Understand the Business — who pays, how money moves
3. List Actors and split the system into Modules
4. Analyze each Requirement (Actor, Trigger, Flows, Rules)
5. Keep a Question Log — never invent answers
6. Self-check: can you explain the project without opening the file?
